score.label: Dissimilarity index, 1990–2020
score.description: D = 0.5 × sum over pools of |share_2020 − share_1990| × 100. Native-born people are counted in the country's primary (founding) pool; known-origin migrants in their birth country's pool; unknown-origin migrants are excluded and the rest is renormalised. Within-pool movement does not change D.

scale.note: Bands follow the observed distribution of D, not the Crime tab’s even 20-point steps. Those 20-point bands would place almost every country in a single colour because D is low for most countries (median 0.5; only three countries are above 20). The first band is split at 0.5, near the median; the top band is open-ended at 10+ (about the 95th percentile).
